# Would a stronger muscle help?

## A bigger pull
Suppose the arm with the cut tendon had a much bigger, stronger biceps. When this muscle contracts, its pull is greater. Will the forearm lift now?

## Still no lift
It will not, because the problem was never a weak pull. The pull still has no way to reach the bone, so a bigger muscle only bunches up more.

## Muscles only pull
A muscle can pull, but it cannot push. So the biceps cannot push the forearm back down. To straighten the arm, the biceps relaxes and a muscle at the back of the upper arm pulls the forearm down.

**Movement needs a pull and a path to the bone. More pull without a path still gives no movement.**
